source: Laxmikanth 8th ed. Ch29 PIL (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-01.txt) p.446 (Krishna Iyer and Bhagwati pioneers); drishtijudiciary.com Mumbai Kamgar Sabha v. Abdulbhai Faizullabhai (1976) ('sown the seeds' of PIL)

NALSA v. Union of India (2014) recognised transgender persons as the third gender and directed that they be treated as socially and educationally backward classes for reservation; option C (worded 'Socially and Economically') is the only option for that category. (Transgender rights; moved.)
source: NALSA v. Union of India (2014) judgment, para 129(3) (indiankanoon.org/doc/193543132)
dispute: Official key / most books: option C (printed 'Socially and Economically Backward Classes'). Strictly, NALSA para 129(3) directs that transgender persons be treated as 'socially and educationally backward classes of citizens' with reservation in admissions and public appointments (indiankanoon.org/doc/193543132).

from_notes: - **Tin Bigha**: corridor **leased** to Bangladesh in **1992** for access to **Dahagram-Angarpota** enclaves (UPSC 1999: Kachchativu and Tin Bigha were handed to Sri Lanka and Bangladesh respectively).
x: Kachchativu was ceded to Sri Lanka in 1974 and the Tin Bigha corridor was given to Bangladesh (leased in perpetuity) – option 2 (UPSC key); they were not French territories, Chinese-annexed areas or leased to India.
source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katchatheevu (1974 agreement recognised Sri Lankan sovereignty); en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tin_Bigha_Corridor ('lease in perpetuity to Bangladesh'); app notes 2:151 sub 0
dispute: UPSC key / most books: both handed over to Sri Lankan and Bangladeshi sovereignty. Strictly, only Kachchativu (1974 agreement) went to Sri Lanka's sovereignty; Tin Bigha is leased in perpetuity to Bangladesh and stays Indian territory (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tin_Bigha_Corridor).

x: Of the options, Nelson Mandela, who led South Africa's struggle against apartheid, is the one called the 'Gandhi of Africa'.
source: theweek.in/news/world/2021/06/18/kenneth-kaunda-statesman-dubbed-africas-gandhi-dies-at-97.html ('Kaunda was dubbed Africa's Gandhi'); key kept as the most-told answer (Kaunda not an option)
